title: MCHeli tank
description: A YAML file in assets/mcheli/tanks/ of an MCHeli addon pack. Generated from the game's schema declarations; do not edit.

DisplayName.description: The name shown in game; the file name when left out. The name, or a map of language codes (en_us, ja_jp) to names where DEFAULT is the name itself. Legacy TXT key: displayname.

Author.description: Who made the vehicle; shown in its tooltip. A name, or a list of names.

ItemID.description: The numeric item id of 1.7 packs; kept for converted packs and not used by the game. Legacy TXT key: itemid.

Category.description: The category shown in the tooltip, such as M.A; the creative tab is sorted by it. The creative tab category, such as M.A; a list is joined with commas. Legacy TXT key: category.

isShaped.description: TXT: the last of 'AddRecipe' (shaped) and 'AddShapelessRecipe' decides.

Pattern.description: TXT: each 'AddRecipe' or 'AddShapelessRecipe' line adds a line, in upper case.

TurretPosition.description: A list [x, y, z] of three numbers.

GlobalUnmountPos.description: Where riders are put when they leave; next to their seat when left out. A list [x, y, z] of three numbers.

CreativeOnly.description: Only players in creative mode can place it. Legacy TXT key: creativeonly.

Regeneration.description: The AI crew regenerate health while someone rides in the vehicle. Legacy TXT key: regeneration.

Invulnerable.description: Nothing damages the vehicle. Legacy TXT key: invulnerable.

MaxFuel.description: Fuel the tank holds; 0 for a vehicle that needs no fuel. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 100000000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxfuel.

FuelType.description: The fluids a vehicle burns: one name, or a map of names to how fast each is used up. A fluid name, or a map of fluid names to how fast each is used up.

MaxHP.description: Hit points when undamaged. The game clamps a value outside 1 to 1000000000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: maxhp.

Stealth.description: How hard the vehicle is to lock on to, from 0 (not at all) to 1. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 1 and says so. Legacy TXT key: stealth.

FuelConsumption.description: How fast the vehicle burns fuel. The game clamps a value outside 0 to 10000 and says so. Legacy TXT key: fuelconsumption.
